title: Flash Safe
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about making a game that is easy on the eyes. Some players can get sick from fast flashing, and some people have seizures from flashing light, so a game should never rely on it. Level 1 shows a hit without a flash: a beep, an ouch face, a number that rises and fewer hit points. Level 2 blinks a small amber lamp once a second and pulses another in soft steps. Level 3 lifts a dark sky a little, holds it, and lets it settle. Signs and still pictures show the wrong way, and the simple rules: no more than 3 flashes in a second, no big red flashes, keep flashing small, and offer other cues. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a time.

box.back: A small explorer in a red beanie has three short rooms that show how to make a game that never relies on a flash. A hit gets a beep, a face, a number and fewer hit points. A warning lamp blinks slowly and small. A storm sky lifts a little and holds. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a time.
features: A hit shown four ways, and none of them a flash
A lamp that blinks once a second and one that pulses softly
A storm sky that lifts, holds and settles
Made to be copied and taken apart
